title: Concerning the Five Things that he constructed with the hard Bodies of the Rulers
teaching_text:
Once again the enlightener speaks: The Living Spirit constructed five great things from veins and skull[s in the] hard [bodies].

The first is the disc that is placed upon [the sh]oulder of the Porter.

The se[con]d are the arches of [the] pillar that is before him.

[The th]ird is the [mou]ld of the fo[r]m for the gehennas.

The fourth are the [seven (?)] pillars that he has erected in the great sea, in [the] seven parts of the universe.

The fifth are the four walls that surround the vessels.
gardner_synopsis: This brief chapter follows the previous, for it discusses intricate details of the work of the Living Spirit in the construction of the universe, utilising parts of the demons that he has destroyed.
